visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room where two young girls are jumping on a beige and black inflatable mattress. One girl is wearing a light pink tutu dress and white tights, while the other wears pink pajamas. They are smiling and laughing as they bounce. Behind them are wooden armchairs with patterned cushions and a wall decorated with a traditional calendar and posters. (2) The girl in pink pajamas performs a high jump and loses her balance as she descends, tipping backward toward the edge of the mattress. The other girl continues to jump nearby. (3) The girl in pajamas falls completely off the mattress, landing head-first in a narrow gap between the airbed and a wooden chair. Her legs are seen flailing in the air while her torso is wedged. The girl in the tutu continues to jump and laugh, looking down at her trapped friend.
